chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Oseas gu mar gu Beeri gu tanoolh gu Osiiyas gu Joataan gu Akâs gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu tanoolh gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Joas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Oseas; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Oseas; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ tu' gu ma'nkam; na gu' gu oidha' maa'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't jix bhɨɨ gu Gomer mar u'vɨ gu Diblaim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jesreel; na gu' tu' gu ɨ'ɨr gu Jesreel bhaan gu vaak gu Jeuu oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh tu' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Lo-ruama; na gu' cham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu vaak gu Israeel gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Gu' gu' gu vaak gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch dodhia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham dodhia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu kuchii tu' bɨɨx tu' bɨɨx kavaayo tu' kavaayo.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lo-ruama gu mar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Lo-ammi; na gu' gu ñi'ook cham gu ja'tkam tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ja'p oo' gu gɨ' suudai' tu' jɨ'xdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' ka't pai' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham gu ja'tkam ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Israeel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n na ba' mo'o gu oidha'; na gu' gu tanoolh gu Jesreel ka't jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' ja'xñi gu ja'tkam gu Ammi sɨspidhi'ñ gu Ruama.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu naan; na gu' cham gu u'vɨ tu' gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu vupui tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' cham ka't tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu tanoolh jix duñia' na ja'p oidha' jix gaki na ja'p gu oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ma'nkam; na gu' gu ma'nkam.
Na gu' na gu' gu naan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na jix mar ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; na gu' jix aa'; jano' ba' tu jiim bhaan gu Dan gu takarui' gu suudai' bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx jo'ii' mia'n bɨɨx cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba'; jano' ba' tu jiim maa'n gu chio'ñ; na gu' tutkɨ jano' ba' jano'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tiriik suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨɨx jix duu gu Baal.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tiriik gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va ka't jix maa na ba'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vupui bhaan gu vupui soo'mchulhdhak gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' jix maa; mi' dhɨr jugi gu vaakax yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Baales tu' bhaan gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' oidha' jix gaki tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu Akôr ki'ñgob nɨɨra; gio ba' na ja'p gu tanoolh gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios mɨmɨim gu Marido gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham pai' dhuuk mɨmɨim gu Baali.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin gu Baales cham pai' dhuuk ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' bɨɨx gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr bɨɨx gu ko'oi gu oidha'; gio ba' u'u gat gu kuchii gu oidha' koox gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na jir bhai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' tu ñi'ook tiriik suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Jesreel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu oidha' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Lo-ruama; gio ba' gu Lo-ammi; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam tu'; jano' ba'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Diijome jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' xoi'kam gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook duiñchu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' na ba' tu' jix toja jodai tɨjɨɨ'ñ kai' vaas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' dhi' mui'x gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr cham tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chio'ñ; jano' ba' tu'.
Na gu' na gu' mui'x gu tanoolh no'm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu gɨ'kora' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu maa'nkar cham dhi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios joi'gɨ'nda' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh.

Na gu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu'r tu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' machia' gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kooda' jix duñia' gu ɨ'ɨr gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu vaakax yooxi' gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu vatop gu gɨ' suudai'.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ cham gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na gu' gu ja'tkam na ja'p jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gio bɨndak jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu naan.

Na gu' gu ja'tkam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' matda'; na gu' tu' matda' tu' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gio tu' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu jodai' na jix uam nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' kua'da' uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' na cham jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ka't gu ja'tkam na ja'p jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu bhóogɨt namkidha' jurtu'nka' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' jugi gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu' cham; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' duñiixim suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix duu tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bɨtaa'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhaan ɨɨbhidham gu kakkavɨk gu vaak na jix bhai' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨtaa'n gu ñi'ook jix bhai' ɨkgiga'n; na ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ma'nkam u'uuvɨ na pai' dhuuk tu' bhaan na pai' dhuuk; na gu' bɨɨx gu u'vɨ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan; na ba' gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Israeel cham gu Judaa; gio ba' cham gu Gilgal tu' gu Bet-aben; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Bibe gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' na ja'p ali' vaakax gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel; gio ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim jix maa duiñxim; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr chiñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jɨvɨl makgɨrxi'ñdha' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' jix duñia' gu Mispa jix vɨgɨ bhaan gu Tabor.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jix dhaam suudai'; na ba' tu' jix duñia' bɨx.
Jano' ba' tu' kakasnira' gu Epraim tu' gu Israeel cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Epraim jix duñia' tu' gu Israeel.
Na gu' cham jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ duñiixim tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' gu Israeel gu Epraim gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gio gu Judaa bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx kakneer bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiim gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix ai'chdhix.
Na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu ma'nkam jix duñia'; gio ba' jano' bɨɨx dɨppɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Gabaa kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu Ramaa; gio ba' gu Bet-aben; mi' dhɨr bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu Benjamiin.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim ka't gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh sɨlhka'n; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maati' tu'r.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Judaa jix bɨɨx duu na ja'p bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim bhaan na ja'p gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu Epraim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jir bhai' na gu' jiim gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim na ja'p gu vaak gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim ko'kdai' gu Judaa tu jiim; gio ba' jano' ba' gu Epraim gu Assur gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Jareb; gu' cham jix duñia' tu' tu jiim.
Na gu' na gu' tu' jix duñia' na ja'p maavɨt gu Epraim na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maavɨt gu vaak gu Judaa; gio ba' tu' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham.
Jano' ba' tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' bɨɨx ka'm uañi'ñ gu vupui; gio ba' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; na; mi' dhɨr naaka'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gook gu tanoolh; gio ba' vaik gu tanoolh oirɨda' duaka' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maati' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ɨlhdham no'ch na ja'p dhuuk na ja'p dhuuk gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Epraim gu Kuee tu' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa jix duñia' na ja'p toov gu xibh na ja'p jupaabkamu'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kuiñcha bɨɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chin; gio ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' ka't na ja'p gu tasi'.
Na gu' na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook cham gu maa'nkar; gio ba' machia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Gu' gu' gu Adam bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ɨ'xkum gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; na gu'.
Jano' ba' gu vaak gu Israeel buupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Epraim gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gio gu Judaa jix dhaas tu' gu vaas dhaibu tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kua' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel jix ñi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Epraim tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Samaria; na gu' jix duñia' iatda'; mi' dhɨr jupaabkamu'n ɨxkum mai'.
Jano' ba' cham tu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ no'ñ chɨ'ñchoka' bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' jano' gu ñi'ook buimɨi; mi' dhɨr vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' bɨɨx tu jiim.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh chulhiiñdha' gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx suudai' u'va; gio ba' gu novɨ bɨɨx.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ nɨidhim gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨx gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr gu xibh jix duñia' na ja'p mɨmɨim gu tai.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ia'rɨ bɨx gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim bhiibgak bɨɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Epraim ka't gu takarui' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' koi'mɨk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel bhaan; gio ba' cham gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx dhi'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Epraim na ja'p gioda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' tɨɨt gu Ejipto gu Asirio.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan jix vɨgɨ jix duñia' na ja'p gu u'uvhig gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' jurtu'nka' tu' naak gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook na gu' jix duñia' tu'; na gu' chajaañ bhaan na gu' bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' tu jiim.
Na pai' dhuuk cham tu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' bhaan Cham na ba' tiriik gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan tu' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' cham gu Altiisimo; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr ia'rɨ chiñia' nɨɨn; jano' ba' ka't gu oidha' gu Ejipto.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk; na gu' ɨlhdham na ja'p gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' bhaan ñi'ook na jix bhaan bhaan ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam; gio ba' bhaamki'ñdha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' gu' tu' cham; mi' dhɨr jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jix duu duiñxim na ba'.
Jano' ba' jix duu tuur gu ñi'ook gu Samaria tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan bɨɨx ka'm cham bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na cham gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bapaalh ka't tuur gu Samaria.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' gu i'bhɨ; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' jootom ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp na ja'p vaaso cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Na gu' na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Assur buur gɨ' kavɨk na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Epraim bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨbɨɨp jano'; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' chiñia'.
Na gu' na gu' jix mui' gu Epraim jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ua'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga jix bɨɨx duu tu'x.
Jano' ba' makgɨrxi'ñdha' juana' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug koi'mɨk; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jano' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' uañi'ñ; jano' ba' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Israeel gu akedor vaak na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix mui' jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk; gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' cham tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx tiriik.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Epraim gu Ejipto gu Asiria pai' jugi gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.

Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam makgɨrxi'ñdha'; gio ba' na ja'p gu takarui' ka't; mi' dhɨr bɨx ka't jix duñia'; jano' ba' ka't gu takarui' na ba'; gio ba' cham gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu kuiñcha chajaañ; gio ba' gu Ejipto gu Mempis; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix toja jodai.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ kuiñcha tu' na cham jir bhai' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨx gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaam suudai' na ja'p gu tanoolh gu Gabaa; gio ba' jano' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p iigɨx bɨɨpɨ' tu' tattat; mi' dhɨr baap gu Baal-peor gu ñi'ook na ba' xi'ɨraam tu' jix duu na ja'p mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim gu u'uvhig gu ñi'ook gɇ'kamtu'nda' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr vook dɨr.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ na gu' gu ñi'ook gio na pai' dhuuk.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nɨidhim gu Tiro pai'; gu' gu Epraim gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook ka't gu Gilgal; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a; mi' dhɨr buimɨi gu vaak; jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' bɨx chiñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham gu i'bhɨ; gio ba' tu' kooda' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim vook.
Na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va gu ñi'ook gu i'bhɨ na ba'; gio ba' jurtu'nka' jix mui' gu i'bhɨ jix mui' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jurtu'nka' joi'gɨ'nda' gu oidha' dhi'.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jano' ka't bakia' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhi'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano'; na gu' cham tañia' gu gɨ'kora' na gu' cham gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' no'ch.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk aa' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix bhaan; na ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' na ja'p yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Bet-aben ka't gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu Samaria; na gu' gu ja'tkam jix duu kuiñcha tuur jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gɇ'kamtu'nda' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't baabuk gu Asiria gu gɨ'kora' gu Jareb; gio ba' gu Epraim ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu Israeel ka't.
Jano' ba' gu Samaria ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Abeen ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu kakkavɨk; jano' ba'; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh gu Gabaa uañi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr cham jix bhɨɨ gu Gabaa bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk gu ja'tkam bhaan na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dha' jix duñia'; gu' tu' bhaan; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Epraim; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa jix duñia' gu Jakob.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx bhai' na ba' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch; gio ba' gu tas na ba' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' jugi gu i'bhɨ gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix búup gu jodai' na jix uam bɨx ka't na ja'p gu Salmaan gu Bet-arbel gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu naan ka't bhaan gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Bet-el tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' gu xibh ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu mar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p tɨɨt jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu Baales gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨt gu Epraim; gio ba' cham jix maati' tu'.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx xoi'kam; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' na ja'p bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan jugi.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto va'k gu Assur ka't gu gɨ'kora' na gu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii bhaan jɨ'dɨlh taañpu'; gio ba' kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam jix bhai'x uañi'ñ bhaan tu'; gio ba' mɨmɨim gu Altiisimo.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Epraim kapbhai' tu' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook tu' na ja'p gu Adma tu' na ja'p gu Seboim gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu'.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu ñi'ook cham na ba' cham tu' duu gu Epraim; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' cham gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; jano' ba' cham ba'k kiicham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p maavɨt; mi' dhɨr maavɨt gu ñi'ook tɨɨda' gu ma'nkam tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu u'uvhig gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Asiria na ja'p gioda'; gio ba' gu vaak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu u'uvhig gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto gu oidha' gu Asiria na ja'p gioda'; gio ba' gu vaak tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Epraim bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Israeel bɨɨx iatda'; gu' gu Judaa bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu jɨvɨl; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chajaañ; na gu' jix duu ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu Asirios bɨ'ñdhatu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook juraa'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu Judaa na ba' jix duñia' gu Jakob jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' buimɨi.
Jano' ba' vook jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xibhɨk bɨɨx gu kavɨk nobii'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam nobii'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Bet-el gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook bɨɨx no'ch.
Gu' gu' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix nukadham xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jup daam bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juraa'n gu novɨ ɨɨxi'ñdha' dha' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Epraim; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gaagam namkɨm na ba' tu'; mi' dhɨr soo'mchulhdhak gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook tu' uañi'ñ bɨx tulhiiña'.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' vaak zel na ja'p gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu novɨ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Galaad gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Gilgal gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ja'p gɨ' kavɨk yooxi'.
Gu' gu' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Aram gu Israeel gu u'vɨ ka't bipia'dam.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Ejipto jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't; gio ba' jix bhai'x tu' gu Epraim gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; na ba' bhaan gu Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu Epraim ua'rgidhimɨk ka't choo'n; gio ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gu' gu Baal jix koi.

Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ jix toja jodai jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' duiñxim bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu xibh na ja'p; gio ba' na ja'p ka't na ja'p kuubh.
Gu' gu' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dɨr gu oidha' gu Ejipto; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios mai' tu' gu Salbador gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' dhi' kuiñcha gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu'.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' na ba' na ja'p maavɨt; gio ba' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p maavɨt; gio ba' gu vaakax yooxi'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu' tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' duukat gu gɨ'kora' na ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx bɨx jɨ'dɨlh tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' chiñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' i'iich daak.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' na cham jir bhai' gu Epraim; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ aajim; gio ba' gu mar cham gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' gu novɨ tukga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi'm; gio ba' gu ñi'ook koi'm tu' jix duñia' koi'm; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' chajaañ gu ñi'ook tukga'n; jano' ba' tɨtdaidha' ka't gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam ɨlhdham gu jɨvɨl gu Jawatan Dios jix tɨ'ɨ baasɨ'n oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' chumñigam bɨx a'bhar.
Na gu' gu Samaria ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr a'aalh ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ja'xñi; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook xoi'kam ali' vaakax.

Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Assur; gio ba' cham bhaan jix duñia' tu' cham pai' dhuuk tu duukam gu ñi'ook gu noobh; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim aagak; na gu' i'iich jix ai'chdhix.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu Israeel na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p jix duñia' na ja'p gu Liibano.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gɇ'kamtu'nda' na ja'p gu Liibano.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨkgiga'n; gio ba' ka't na ja'p tiriik na ja'p; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook na ja'p suudai' u'va gu Liibano.
Jano' ba' gu Epraim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx duiñxim tu' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr tu' jix duñia' na ja'p ka't gu vaas; jano' ba' tu' ka't gaagam gu i'bhɨ.
Na gu' chɨkka jix maat na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai' ja'tkam; gu'.
